observations.observation:
Visible: A centered white card fits horizontally with generous side margins. Heading "Create your account" and gray subtitle are left-aligned with clear spacing. Labels sit above each control, left-aligned with input edges. The Role select matches input widths, full card width. The notification row shows three roughly equal segments—"All updates," "Weekly digest" (selected, pale green tint), "Minimal"—all fitting the row without wrapping. The blue "Create account" button is full-width and prominent.

Limitation: The small note "Local preview — nothing is sent to a server." sits flush at the image's bottom edge; the card's bottom padding and rounded edge are not visible. Inference: the card is likely vertically clipped (capture metadata confirms cropping), so the note's spacing below cannot be verified.

Observed: the card sits with gray margins left/right and above; heading "Create your account," subtitle, "Full name" field ("Ada Lovelace"), "Work email" field with the "Format: name@company.com" hint, "Role" select ("Choose an option"), and the three-option notification row ("Weekly digest" highlighted green) are all fully readable, left-aligned, with even vertical rhythm. The blue "Create account" button and the centered note "Local preview — nothing is sent to a server." are visible with white padding below the note.

However, the card's white surface runs to the image's bottom edge — no bottom rounded corners or gray strip beneath are visible — so the bottom edge appears cut off at the capture boundary, and the bottom edge/padding cannot be confirmed. Spacing otherwise reads balanced and compact.

**Card containment (direct observation):** The white card's bottom edge sits fully within the frame — its lower rounded corners are visible, with a slim light-gray/blue background strip beneath before the viewport edge. No clipping is apparent on any side; left, right, and top margins also show background around the card.

**Spacing (direct observation):** The compact layout reads polished: consistent ~30–40px rhythm between label/input groups, small clear gap between each label and its field, helper text ("Format: name@company.com") sits close under the email input without crowding, and the blue button and footer note ("Local preview — nothing is sent to a server.") have comfortable clearance above the card's bottom edge.

**Inference/limitations:** Exact pixel margins are estimates; behavior below the fixed 585px viewport is unverifiable.
